statement.text:
Let G be a group with a normal (pro-) 2-subgroup N such that G/N is isomor-
phic to GLn (2), inducing its natural module on N/Φ(N ), the Frattini factor-group
of N . For n = 3 determine G such that N is as large as possible. (For n > 3 it can be
proved that already the Frattini subgroup Φ(N ) of N is trivial; for n = 2 there exists
G such that N is the free pro-2-group generated by two elements).         B. Baumann
